summary: IBEX Limited filed an 8-K on May 13, 2026 announcing its board authorized a $20 million share repurchase program starting May 14, 2026, over one year. Repurchases may be made through open market, privately negotiated, or block trades at management's discretion, subject to market conditions and Rule 10b-18/10b5-1 compliance. The program is funded from existing cash, does not obligate any specific amount, and can be suspended or discontinued anytime. No price per share, premium, or advisor is disclosed. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on shares outstanding; no risk-arb angle as this is a routine capital return, not an M&A event.
